cause: initSocketConnection registered incoming_challenge but not incoming_room_invite/status events. The latter were installed only by setupSocketListeners during later game/room entry.
fix: Idempotent setupRoomInviteListeners registers the same five existing invitation handlers immediately when the socket is created and when game listeners are set up. No reward/server/acceptance behavior change.
